verdict.rationale: Attio's marketing and docs show users can customize fields and define custom objects and attributes (attio-docs-46, attio-docs-66, attio-docs-8), and can view data as kanbans or tables (attio-docs-34), with lists available for organizing records (attio-docs-83, attio-docs-29). However, the only filter and sort evidence covers REST API request parameters, not UI views, and no evidence shows views being shared or confirms these changes need no admin. Missing for 10: documented UI view filtering and sorting, shared or team view capabilities, evidence that non-admin ops users can add fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
